title: Business questions
summary: Ask analysis questions about deals, buyers and your product in chat, without writing a document.

steps.title: Ask from general knowledge
steps.goal: Answer market questions such as why deals stall, what makes buyers say yes or no, and what they expect from a product like ours
steps.note: AA-Omniscience Business matters most here: the answer comes from the model's memory, so it must not make up facts.

steps.title: Analyse our own deals
steps.goal: Find why our deals were won or lost and what clients asked for, from deal notes, emails, client feedback or CRM exports
steps.note: Paste the material into the chat. The model reasons from your evidence, so its own business knowledge matters less.

steps.title: Challenge the conclusion
steps.goal: Attack the answer: which claims lack evidence, what was missed, and which other explanation fits the facts
steps.note: Use a fresh chat and a different model from steps 1 and 2.
